title: Crispy Chickpeas with Spinach and Eggs
subtitle: Mediterranean pan of crispy chickpeas, wilted spinach, and baked eggs
excerpt: Chickpeas fried until crispy, tossed with wilted spinach and spices, then eggs baked directly in the pan. A one-pan meal that works for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from Mediterranean chickpea and egg traditions. Patting the chickpeas completely dry before frying is essential for crispiness.

content.text: Dry the chickpeas on a tea towel and press out any surface moisture before they go in the pan. Wet chickpeas will not crisp.

items.prepNote: 2 x 400g tins, drained and patted thoroughly dry

content.text: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chickpeas in a single layer. Cook without stirring for 4 to 5 minutes until the undersides are golden.
Toss and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes until crispy on most sides. Season with salt.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and chilli flakes. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach in two or three handfuls. Toss after each addition until wilted. Squeeze over the lemon juice.
Make 4 wells in the pan. Crack one egg into each well. Cover the pan with a lid or foil.
Cook on medium-low heat for 3 to 5 minutes until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Scatter crumbled feta over the top. Serve straight from the pan.

items.symptom: Chickpeas are soft and chewy, not crispy.
items.cause: Still damp when they went into the oil.
items.fix: Dry thoroughly with a tea towel and press firmly before frying.

items.symptom: Egg whites are not setting with the lid on.
items.fix: Keep on medium heat, not low; it should take 3 to 5 minutes.

items.symptom: Spinach released a lot of water into the pan.
items.cause: Added all at once before it wilted.
items.fix: Add in two batches and toss each until wilted before adding the next.
